name: Welterman International Limited
summary: Welterman International Ltd. primarily operates in the commerce of leather used for footwear. The company is also involved in the production and distribution of a diverse range of shoe soles, encompassing varieties such as leather, rubber, thermoplastic rubber (TPR), thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), and polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Additionally, they supply custom-injected soles and leather soles combined with masonite heels. Kayum Razak Dhanani founded the firm on May 13, 1992, and its corporate base is located in Vadodara, India.
